headline: Peru and El Salvador Make Progress on Free Trade Agreement Negotiations
summary: Peruvian President Keiko Fujimori announced that negotiations for a free trade agreement with El Salvador have advanced, with 14 of 19 chapters resolved.
why: Bilateral trade agreements reduce tariffs and regulatory barriers, potentially boosting cross-border commerce and investment opportunities for businesses in both countries.

impacts.name: Peru
impacts.why: Trade agreements can stimulate bilateral economic exchange and market access.
